title: Factory Audit — Request a Factory Audit
purpose: Request a social-compliance or quality audit for a factory, such as SEDEX, BSCI, FAMA or WRAP, and track the audit jobs in one list.
meta: Factory Audit → Create Factory Audit Order
overview: Open **Factory Audit** in the left menu.
Step 1 **Audit Requirements**: choose the audit scheme and date.
Step 2 **Factory**: enter the factory and its contact.
Click **Submit**, or **Save Draft** to finish later.

body: In the left menu, open **Factory Audit**. The **Jobs** tab lists your audit jobs with the factory name and address, audit scheme, creator, team, audit date, date created and job status. Use **Audit Scheme**, **Job Status**, **Sort by Date**, **Created By** and **Team** to filter, or search by factory name. Click **Reset** to clear the filters.
Click **Create Factory Audit Order** at the top right.

list: **Audit Scheme**: SEDEX 4P, SEDEX 2P, BSCI, FAMA, WRAP or Other.
For SEDEX, choose the **announcement type** (Announced, Semi-announced or Unannounced) and answer **Are you SEDEX Member?** (Yes, No or Provide Later). If you answer Yes, enter your SEDEX no.
**Audit Date**: the date you want the audit.

body: Click **Next**, or **Save Draft** to finish later.

list: **1. Factory Info**: factory name in English (and the local-language name if you have it), location (country/region, province, city), address and number of employees.
**2. Factory Contact**: contact person, contact number, email address and factory telephone.

body: Click **Submit** to send the request, or **Save Draft** to finish later. The job then appears in the **Jobs** list.

tips: Use the Home page **Attention** card for Factory Audit to see audit jobs that need your action.
Save a draft if you are waiting for the factory's contact details.
faq: Which audit schemes can I request?
SEDEX 4P, SEDEX 2P, BSCI, FAMA, WRAP, or Other.
Can I finish the request later?
Yes. Click Save Draft on either step.
Where do I see my audit jobs?
Open Factory Audit in the left menu. The Jobs tab lists every audit job and its status.
